# vendor/

`three.r128.min.js`: Three.js r128 daripada repositori rasmi mrdoob/three.js (tag `r128`, `build/three.min.js`). Lesen MIT, lihat `LICENSE-three.txt`.

`node scripts/build.mjs` membenam fail ini ke dalam `index.html`. Jika fail ini dibuang, permainan memuat Three.js dari CDN.
*Three.js r128 from the official repository (MIT). The build embeds it into index.html; without it the game falls back to CDNs.*
